profile.name: Name
profile.sessionsHint: Ending all sessions signs you out on every device.
profile.deactivateHint: Deactivation is reversible: sign-in is blocked, the Telegram link is removed and scheduled notifications are cancelled. An administrator can restore access.
profile.confirmDeactivateHint: You will be signed out and sign-in will be blocked until an administrator restores it.
profile.emailHint: Until the new address is confirmed, sign-in keeps working with the old one.
profile.emailSentHint: The address changes only after confirming via the link in the email
profile.avatar_urlHint: An image at this address replaces the initials. An empty field brings them back.
profile.bioHint: Free text, at most {{count}} characters. Other participants can see it.
profile.nicknameHint: 3 to 39 characters: latin letters, digits, hyphen and underscore. The profile will be served at /@nickname
profile.nicknameEmpty: Without a nickname the public profile is unavailable
profile.legacyTitle: Check how the name was split
profile.legacyHint: The name used to be stored as a single string and was split automatically, so the parts may have landed wrong. The original value was "{{value}}". Save the form to confirm the split.
profile.visibilityHint: While the switch is off, the /@nickname page is available to nobody but you.

links.title: Links
links.hint: Add any address: the kind of link is recognised from it, so nothing has to be picked from a list.
links.reorderFailed: Could not save the new order
links.urlHint: A page on any service, or your own site.
links.detectedNone: The service is not recognised, an ordinary link icon will be shown.
links.label: Caption
links.labelHint: Optional. Replaces the service name in the list.
links.limitReached: The maximum number of links has been reached.

profile.publicNotFound: The profile was not found or is closed

account.identityHint: The email address you sign in with, and your role in the system.
account.telegramHint: Linking is what allows notifications to be delivered over Telegram.
account.telegramDeepLinkHint: Open the link and send the start command to the bot:

devices.title: Devices
devices.hint: Sessions that are signed in right now. Ending one signs out that device only.
devices.revokeFailed: The session could not be ended
devices.revokeCurrentHint: This is the device you are using. Ending it signs you out here.
devices.emptyHint: You are signed in on this device only.

settings.title: Settings
settings.themeHint: Light, dark, or follow the system setting.
settings.languageHint: Applies to this browser. Notifications use the language stored in your profile.
settings.timezoneHint: All dates and deadlines are shown in this zone. Everything is stored in UTC.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.settingsHint: Built from the registry: what is in effect right now, by scope. Changes apply at once, without a reload.
shortcuts.emptyHint: This screen has not registered any shortcuts.
shortcuts.remapNote: A shortcut is recorded by pressing it: choose Change and press the keys. A shortcut that is taken or belongs to the browser is not accepted.
shortcuts.reservedBrowser: This shortcut belongs to the browser
shortcuts.reservedSystem: This shortcut belongs to the operating system
shortcuts.reservedFocus: This key is needed to move around the interface
